bias.en: Uptrend · cleared the October high, SAR turned bullish
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破 10 月高点，SAR 转多

read.en: Zscaler rose 2.8% on Oct 22 to $237.76, trading between $231.64 and $241.12 on 1.3 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($220.7), rising 10-day ($223.3), rising 30-day ($208.2), rising 100-day ($169.7) and falling 200-day ($165.9) averages. MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 22 and is above zero; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 22 ($203.33), and RSI is 66.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月22日上涨 2.8%，收于 $237.76，盘中区间 $231.64–241.12，成交量为平均水平的 1.3 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$220.7）、上行的 10 日（$223.3）、上行的 30 日（$208.2）、上行的 100 日（$169.7）和下行的 200 日均线（$165.9）上方。MACD 于 10月22日上穿信号线，位于零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 于 10月22日转为看多（$203.33），RSI 为 66。

read.en: The close cleared the $237.2 Oct 12 high, which now becomes support, and the SAR flipped bullish as flagged. Resistance is $241.1 (Oct 22 high), then $250 (round number). Support is $237.2, then $231.6–232.1 (Oct 22 low, Oct 21 high) and $220.7–223.3 (5 and 10-day). A close above $241.1 would target $250; a close below $231.6 would reopen $221–223.
read.zh: 收盘突破 10月12日高点 $237.2，该位置转为支撑，SAR 也如预期转为看多。阻力为 $241.1（10月22日高点），其次 $250（整数关口）。支撑为 $237.2，其次 $231.6–232.1（10月22日低点、10月21日高点）和 $220.7–223.3（5 日和 10 日均线）。若收盘站上 $241.1，下一目标看 $250；若收盘跌破 $231.6，将重新打开 $221–223。
